title: The Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
summary: Travelling salesman Gregor Samsa wakes to find he has turned into a giant insect. The story follows how his family and employer react as he becomes more isolated.
readIf: you want a very short, strange classic that you can read in one sitting and think about for a long time.
skipIf: you want an explanation, because the book never gives one.

pairings.reason: Another Kafka story of a man caught in a system he cannot understand.
Another short, cool novel about an outsider and society's cold reaction to him.
A warmer, stranger and more modern novel that owes something to Kafka.
